scenes.description: Invite Lamp to ask a yes/no question
scenes.expectation: Lamp asks one short yes/no question.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.expectation: Keep the sky-colour context and answer without the name.
scenes.precondition: Lamp has just answered the first follow-up.

scenes.expectation: Answer the corrected request (thirty-six), not the abandoned one.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Fast speech at the catalog's maximum rate
scenes.expectation: Accept the whole question and answer 210 minutes.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Addressed question 18 dB quieter than the ordinary fixtures
scenes.expectation: Accept the quiet question and answer four.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: Listener says yeah while Lamp talks
scenes.expectation: Keep talking; this is not a new request.

scenes.description: Listener says right, okay while Lamp talks
scenes.expectation: Keep talking; this is not a new request.

scenes.description: Natural topic change later in Lamp's answer
scenes.expectation: Yield promptly, preserve the new request and answer the coffee question.

scenes.description: Follow-up asked almost as soon as Lamp stops
scenes.expectation: Keep context and answer without the name.
scenes.precondition: Lamp has just answered a question.

scenes.description: A question paused mid-sentence, then finished
scenes.expectation: Wait through the 1.4 s pause and answer the whole question (Venus).
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: The first half of a question only
scenes.expectation: Ideally wait; any reply is judged by the continuation.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: The person finishes the question after Lamp started replying
scenes.expectation: Yield and answer the whole question (Venus).
scenes.precondition: Lamp is audibly replying to the fragment.

scenes.description: A second natural interruption with a new topic
scenes.expectation: Yield again and answer the sky question.
scenes.precondition: Lamp is audibly answering the previous interruption.

scenes.description: A third natural interruption with a new topic
scenes.expectation: Yield again and answer the ocean question.
scenes.precondition: Lamp is audibly answering the previous interruption.

scenes.description: The owner asks a question while two colleagues talk quietly nearby
scenes.expectation: Answer four; ignore the background conversation.
scenes.precondition: Lamp awake and input verified; no active conversation unless specified.

scenes.description: A new question a few seconds after the previous answer ended
scenes.expectation: Answer four in the continuing session.
scenes.precondition: Lamp answered and the provider may have disconnected since.

scenes.description: A colleague speaks nearby while Lamp answers
scenes.expectation: Keep answering; the remark is not addressed to Lamp.
